traceability.notes: Performance data extracted by claude-sonnet-5 reading the PDF directly (native document input), used as a fallback because the deterministic pdfplumber pipeline (summary_report_parser.py) found no per-category breakdown in this report. Model's own extraction notes: Table 5 (pages 17-18) is organized by protocol (double step enrichment protocol 1 at 6h and 22h; short protocols 2-6) and 12 ISO 16140-2 categories, each with sub-types (a,b,c) whose per-subtype rows were summed into "Total" rows per category - only these category Total rows were recorded here (sub-type rows omitted as they are not full categories). Summary rows "All categories, paired and unpaired with protocol 1 at 6h/22h" were excluded per instructions as they are overall aggregates, not individual food categories. This report also contains an inter-laboratory study (Table 32) reporting overall SEalt=100%, SEref=100%, RT=100%, FPR=0% at 6h, but this is a single aggregate result (not per-category) for the ILS phase and was not included in the per-category table. The report includes both an initial/renewal study (ADRIA) and an extension study performed by Microsept in 2025 for category 12 (Cocoa and chocolate products); only the Microsept-derived Total values for category 12 appear in Table 5 and were used directly since no separate ADRIA-only breakdown for category 12 was given.
